description: This file defines a class 'AzureBlobStorageGrainStorageProviderBuilder' that implements the 'IProviderBuilder' interface for configuring Azure Blob Storage as a grain storage provider within Orleans Silo. It contains logic to set up the storage options based on configuration settings, including container name, service key, connection string, and serializer key.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageGrainStorageProviderBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds and configures Azure Blob Storage grain storage provider for Orleans Silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Azure Blob Storage grain storage provider using settings from the provided configuration section.
